# @ndigo/socket

Ndigo Socket — isomorphic WebSocket domain: client contract + implementation and server-side session contracts

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `SocketRequestSources` *(type)* — Request sources captured from the upgrade request — the same vocabulary HTTP handlers use (`query`/`headers`/`cookies`), so WebSocket handlers can read and val…
- `SocketSession` *(type)* — A live WebSocket connection as seen by a socket handler.
- `SocketSessionRegistry` *(type)* — Tracks live WebSocket sessions and broadcasts to them.
- `SocketSessionRegistryAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a SocketSessionRegistry.
- `AsSocketSessionRegistryAware` — Mixes socket-session-registry awareness into a base class.
- `likeSocketSessionRegistryAware` — Tests whether a value looks like socket-session-registry-aware state.

- `SocketStatus` *(type)*
- `SocketTransport` *(type)* — The structural WHATWG `WebSocket` subset the client depends on.
- `ReconnectPolicy` *(type)* — Exponential backoff policy for unexpected-close reconnects.
- `ReconnectTrigger` *(type)* — Environment wiring for an immediate retry (e.g. the browser `online` event — `ndigo-platform-web` provides an implementation).
- `WebSocketClientOptions` *(type)* — Options for `WebSocketClient`.
- `SocketClient` *(type)* — The client contract — what handlers, views, and services consume.
- `WebSocketClient` — WHATWG-`WebSocket`-based client with reconnect.
- `STOMPBody` *(type)* — STOMP frame contracts.
- `STOMPFrame` *(type)* — A parsed STOMP frame. `command: ''` marks a heart-beat ping. *
- `STOMPWireInput` *(type)* — Byte-like inputs the codec accepts (binary WS frames, node Buffers).
- `STOMPProtocolError` — Error thrown when a STOMP frame is malformed.
- `parseStompFrame` — Parse a wire frame into its command/headers/body.
- `parseTextFrame` — Parse a text frame (string input).
- `serializeStompFrame` — Serialize a frame to the wire format (NUL-terminated, escaped headers).
- `bodyAsText` — Interpret a STOMP body as text (UTF-8 for byte bodies).
- `STOMPAckMode` *(type)* — STOMP ack modes (STOMP 1.2 §1.3.1).
- `STOMPBrokerOptions` *(type)* — STOMPBrokerOptions.
- `STOMPBroker` — STOMP 1.2 broker — transport-agnostic, one instance per destination namespace (app-scoped entry).
- `STOMPMessage` *(type)* — A MESSAGE frame delivered to a subscription. The body is the wire payload verbatim — a string for text frames, bytes for binary; `json()` parses either (bytes…
- `STOMPClientOptions` *(type)* — Options for STOMPClient.
- `STOMPSubscription` *(type)* — A live subscription: an async iterable of MESSAGE frames. *
- `STOMPClient` — STOMP 1.2 client over any SocketClient.
- `materialOctets` — Body size as transmitted: UTF-8 octets for text, raw length for bytes. Shared by the store's byte budget and the broker's transaction budget.
- `headerOctets` — Serialized header size as transmitted: for every entry, the UTF-8 octets of its name and value plus the `:` separator and the line's EOL. Shared by the broker'…
- `StoredQueueMessage` *(type)* — A stored `/queue` message — the durable unit behind the backlog.
- `QueueStoreRetention` *(type)* — What a caller asks the store to retain.
- `QueueMessageStore` *(type)* — The store contract: append, ordered replay, retention pruning.
- `InMemoryQueueStoreOptions` *(type)* — Options for `InMemoryQueueMessageStore`.
- `InMemoryQueueStoreStats` *(type)* — A snapshot of `InMemoryQueueMessageStore` retention (`InMemoryQueueMessageStore.stats`).
- `InMemoryQueueMessageStore` — In-memory queue message store.

- `SocketFanoutScope` *(type)* — Cross-node live socket fan-out. No persistence, replay, or queue distribution.
- `SocketFanoutMessage` *(type)* — Already serialized wire payload; topic headers are application headers only.
